item.title: Iran protests: Tehran accuses US of incitement as claims put death toll above 2,500
item.description: The death toll from Iran’s ongoing crackdown on anti-government protests has risen to at least 2,571, according to activists, marking the deadliest wave of unrest the country has seen in decades.

item.title: US lawmakers divided over Greenland as Danish leaders head to White House
item.description: US Congress is split over Greenland as senior Danish and Greenlandic leaders head to the White House this week, amid renewed controversy sparked by President Donald Trump’s remarks on the strategically important Arctic territory.

item.title: Missing UP tourists rescued in Ladakh after being stranded in sub-zero cold
item.description: Four tourists from Uttar Pradesh who went missing during a trip to Pangong Lake have been safely rescued in Ladakh after a coordinated search operation by the police, officials said on Tuesday.

item.title: Adani and money power dominate high-stakes BMC civic poll campaign in Mumbai
item.description: Campaigning for Maharashtra’s 29 civic polls, including BMC, ended Tuesday with public issues taking a backseat. The narrative instead revolved around Gautam Adani and allegations of money power shaping the contest ahead of the January 15 vote.

item.title: Maharashtra poll body restricts door-to-door campaigning after formal canvassing ends
item.description: Maharashtra SEC bars civic poll candidates from using mics or moving in large groups for door-to-door campaigning, allowing only limited personal outreach after public campaign ends.

item.title: US labels Egyptian, Lebanese and Jordanian Muslim Brotherhood branches as terrorists
item.description: The United States has designated the Egyptian, Lebanese and Jordanian branches of the Muslim Brotherhood as “terrorist organisations,” citing their alleged support for the Hamas militant group.

item.title: GRAP tackles symptoms, not root causes of Delhi’s air pollution: experts
item.description: Environmentalists say emergency curbs offer short-term relief but fail to deliver lasting clean air

item.title: US president warns Iran of ‘very strong action’ if protesters are hanged
item.description: US President Trump warns of “very strong action” if Iran begins hanging anti-government protesters, amid one of the country’s deadliest waves of unrest in years.

item.title: November 2024 violence: Court orders FIR against 12 policemen in Sambhal, including former circle officer
item.description: Taking cognisance of the November 2024 violence in Sambhal, a Chief Judicial Magistrate has ordered the registration of an FIR against 12 police personnel, including the then Circle Officer of Sambhal, Anuj Chaudhary

item.title: Crane collapse on passenger train in Thailand kills at least 12
item.description: Crane collapse on passenger train in Thailand kills 12
